extension.summary: Shows what the player is doing: video, audio, HDR and Dolby Vision output
extension.description: An overlay with the codec, video, audio, HDR and Dolby Vision details of what is playing, and what the box is sending to the display. Runs on LibreELEC, including the Intel Dolby Vision build, and on CoreELEC. Based on the TinyPPI code by U3knOwn (AGPL-3.0-or-later); not affiliated with or supported by TinyPPI's author. Report problems at https://github.com/dangerouslaser/script.bald.processinfo/issues.
extension.news: v2.15.3 - Web dashboard: the token travels in a request header only, never in a URL; the live stream and pictures use a session cookie instead. - Web dashboard: reading without the token works on the home network only, and the lockout after wrong tokens counts per device. - Web dashboard: fixed shelves that went wrong while the library changed or during a search, the cover tint, the bar colour on load; a dashboard that cannot start is now handled cleanly. - Resume points, frame rates and luminance values Kodi reports as invalid no longer break the display. - Colour settings with non-Latin digits are read correctly, and missing translations fall back to English. - Share passwords no longer appear in the log.
